name: cognitive-overlay
description: Zero-distraction in-IDE overlay for developer studies: fatigue Likert sampling, stuck detection with inline code prompts, and session telemetry.
author: HPI Research

commands.title: Cognitive Overlay: Open Study Data Folder
Cognitive Overlay: Respond to Stuck Prompt

cognitiveOverlay.participantId.description: Default participant ID (can be overridden when starting a session).

cognitiveOverlay.condition.description: A/B study condition for this session.

cognitiveOverlay.session.durationMinutes.description: Study session length in minutes. The end-of-study survey opens automatically when time is up.

cognitiveOverlay.fatigue.intervalMinutes.description: How often the fatigue Likert prompt appears during a session.

cognitiveOverlay.fatigue.waitForPauseSec.description: The fatigue prompt waits for a typing pause of at least this many seconds before appearing (zero-distraction). It gives up waiting after 60s and shows anyway.

cognitiveOverlay.fatigue.jitterPercent.description: Randomize each fatigue probe interval by ±this percent so participants can't anticipate probes (reduces experience-sampling reactivity). 0 = strictly periodic.

cognitiveOverlay.fatigue.quietTailMinute.description: Suppress fatigue probes during the final minutes of the session - a probe answered just before the debrief is redundant and annoying.

cognitiveOverlay.stuck.enabled.description: Detect when the participant appears stuck and show an inline prompt on the code.

cognitiveOverlay.stuck.thresholdSeconds.description: Seconds of dwelling on the same code region without edits (while still active) before the stuck prompt appears.

cognitiveOverlay.stuck.languages.description: Language IDs to watch for stuck detection (e.g. ["python"]). Empty = all languages.

cognitiveOverlay.session.taskId.description: Protocol task ID recorded in the environment snapshot (replication provenance).

cognitiveOverlay.session.agentTool.description: AI agent tool used in the ai-assisted condition (e.g. claude-code), recorded in the environment snapshot.

cognitiveOverlay.session.agentModelId.description: Model identifier of the AI agent (e.g. claude-fable-5), recorded in the environment snapshot.

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.enabled.description: Master switch for the behavioral telemetry leg (focus, scroll, edit bursts, clipboard, AI lifecycle, saves, heartbeats).

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.captureFocus.description: Record editor/tab focus switches and window focus state (editor_focus events).

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.captureVisible.description: Record debounced visible line ranges for scroll-coverage analysis (visible_range events).

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.captureEditBur.description: Record aggregated edit bursts with origin classification (edit_burst events). Sizes and shapes only - never text content.

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.captureClipboa.description: Record clipboard paste sizes and internal-copy latency (clipboard_paste events). Clipboard text is never read or stored.

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.captureAiLifec.description: Record the AI-completion lifecycle: shown/accepted/rejected/dismissed with review latency (ai_suggestion events).

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.captureAttenti.description: Record region-level time-on-code from caret + mouse-hover dwell (attention events). Line numbers and durations only - never code content.

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.languages.description: Language IDs captured by the behavioral leg (pilot: python only). Empty = all languages.

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.workspaceInter.description: Capture only files inside the workspace. Files outside are recorded as 'external' in focus events and otherwise ignored.

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.burstGapMs.description: An edit burst closes after this many milliseconds without further edits.

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.aiCorrelationM.description: An edit burst within this window of an accepted AI suggestion is classified origin=ai.

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.aiBlockCharThr.description: A block of at least this many characters landing within aiBlockMaxDurationMs is classified origin=ai (injected, not typed).

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.aiBlockMaxDura.description: Window for the AI block-injection heuristic - humans do not type aiBlockCharThreshold characters this fast.

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.pasteCorrelati.description: An edit burst within this window of a clipboard paste is classified origin=paste.

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.idleWindowSeco.description: No interaction for this long marks the participant idle (heartbeat state transition).

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.focusDebounceM.description: Debounce for editor focus switches - rapid tab-cycling records first + last.

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.attentionRegio.description: Caret/hover may wander +/- this many lines and still count as the same attention region.

cognitiveOverlay.behavior.attentionMinDw.description: Attention regions with less present-and-active time than this are dropped as pass-through glances.

cognitiveOverlay.output.directory.description: Directory for JSONL study data. Empty = <workspace>/.study-data (or extension global storage if no workspace).

cognitiveOverlay.output.httpEndpoint.description: Optional middleware endpoint to POST event batches to (e.g. http://localhost:8000/cognitive). Empty = disabled.

cognitiveOverlay.studyId.description: The study this IDE is paired to (set automatically when you connect).

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
